相对触发器计时；重新启用或重置会影响计时。: Time relative to the trigger; reenabling or resetting affects timing.

科技门槛由主、次小队成员的科技等级计算；字段 3 原文不决定门槛。国家使用国家列: Tech requirements follow primary/secondary team members, not raw field 3. Country uses a country-list ID. The engine discards field 11 and only stores field 13; raw text is preserved.

群岛仅尝试在没有玩家起点的岛屿上放置；各地貌均可能因随机结果或缺少合适位置而不生: Archipelagos attempt placement only on islands without player starts. Any landscape may produce none due to random results or a lack of suitable locations.
群岛的海陆布局由生成器决定，此选项不生效。其他地貌中数值越大，水域通常越多；不代: The generator determines the land and sea layout of archipelagos, so this setting has no effect there. Higher values usually produce more water in other landscapes; they are not actual coverage percentages.
能力提示依据固定的 VERA20k 源码；未知参数可保留/编辑原文，未列入清单不: Capability notes refer to the pinned VERA20k source. Unknown parameters can be kept or edited as raw text; unlisted features may still be supported by the engine.
自动 LAT 会修补边缘，浅蓝色标出范围外的过渡调整。: Automatic LAT repairs edges; light blue marks transition changes outside the fill area.
自动放置桥面；高桥同时替换桥头。绿色可放置，红色说明原因，Esc 取消。: Places the deck automatically; elevated bridges also replace bridgeheads. Green allows placement, red explains obstacles; Esc cancels.
自动识别所选高台的低地高度；悬崖高差为 4 层。: Detects the selected plateau's low ground automatically; cliffs span 4 levels.
自动选择当前环境资源；保护建筑、对象、桥面和特殊地形。绿色可放置，红色说明原因，: Selects current theater assets automatically and protects buildings, objects, decks, and special terrain. Green allows placement; red explains obstacles; Esc cancels.

节点只规划 AI 建造位置，不直接放置建筑；建造仍需施工场、资金和 AI 生产启: Nodes only plan AI building locations. Construction requires a construction yard, funds, and enabled AI production.
裁切可删除越界对象、覆盖物、格子标签、基地节点和整条隧道。越界航点、桥梁、脚本目: Clipping removes out-of-bounds objects, overlays, cell tags, base nodes, and whole tunnels. Adjust waypoints, bridges, script destination cells, and mission view rectangles first. Shared tags are retained. Building bounds use the current art footprint.

非 incoming House 的 Sleep 移动对象，无敌对过滤。: Sleep mobile objects outside the incoming house, without hostility filtering.

高侧生成窄高台，末端和后侧自动封口。接续时合并高地并移除内部旧崖壁；可用高台工具: Creates a narrow plateau on the high side and closes its ends and back. Extensions merge high ground and remove internal cliffs. Use the plateau tool to expand it further.
高度跟随鼠标下的格子；所选锚点与该格等高。: Height follows the cell under the pointer; the anchor aligns to that cell's height.
高空对象每 16 帧发布通知。: High-altitude objects emit a notification every 16 frames.
鼠标对齐选区的最小坐标角，点击放置；Esc 退出。: The pointer aligns to the selection's minimum-coordinate corner. Click to place; Esc exits.
使用试玩设置中的 VERA20k 引擎生成高清地图预览，最长边 4096 像素。: Generate an HD preview with the VERA20k executable selected in playtest settings, up to 4096 pixels per side. Includes unsaved edits and uses the game renderer.
